subject: Champion onboarding play & boardroom reserve
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha@hightower.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Champion onboarding play & boardroom reserve

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time this week. As discussed, I put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) and an approach for mapping Hightower execs to Redwood roles so we can lock an EB (executive briefing) and the boardroom slot that aligns to your procurement window. Attached: MAP-draft-v1.pdf and a tentative boardroom availability .ics I pulled from Alan’s calendar notes.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm the sponsor (exec champion) who will brief internally on Oct 20–27 window.
- Confirm which two EB time-slots your execs prefer so we can reserve the boardroom and send formal invites.
- Procurement checklist items we should prepare (SOW highlights, security addendum, final SLA ask).

Proposed owner map (quick):
- Hightower exec sponsor: (you / Alan) — primary decision maker on budget
- Redwood exec: Marissa (deal executive) — will run the EB and negotiate final commercial terms
- SE deep-dive owner: Rishi — will run the tech session and the evaluation plan

If that ownership looks reasonable, I’ll update the MAP and convert the two preferred EB slots into calendar holds.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0183

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (12 pages, draft); boardroom-availability.ics

From: Samantha Liu <samantha@hightower.com>

Cc: Alan Pierce <alan.pierce@hightower.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Champion onboarding play & boardroom reserve

Jordan —

Appreciate the MAP draft. Quick answers:
- Sponsor will be Alan Pierce (CFO) — he will lead finance alignment and present to the board. I’m the program lead and will coordinate the EB logistics.
- Procurement timeline: target signature by end of November; legal needs a redline of the SOW and the SOC 2 evidence. Procurement (procurement@hightower.com) looped on this thread.

Preferred EB time-slots (our side):
1) Tue Oct 20, 10:30–12:00 PT
2) Wed Oct 21, 14:00–15:30 PT

Both would work but Alan prefers the morning slot on Oct 20 if possible.

I uploaded our internal pre-read placeholder here: https://hightower.share/board-prep (will replace with final once Alan approves).

Thanks,
Samantha Liu
Head of Cloud Platforms | Hightower Systems
samantha@hightower.com

Folks —

Thanks for looping me in. Good news on the sponsor being Alan. Quick internal asks:
- Jordan: please update the MAP to mark Alan as sponsor and add the procurement milestones (legal redline, SOC 2 review, KMS requirements).
- Rishi: prepare an evaluation plan (30/60/90 day) with concrete success criteria we can share at the EB — focus on latency targets for critical pipelines and data segregation notes.
- I'll take ownership of the commercial timeline and propose an internal approval path at Redwood to fast-track pricing approvals for board-level asks.

Also, attach SOW-highlights.docx to the next send — legal will want to see that up front. I’ll prep an exec one-pager for Alan that calls out risk mitigations and the fallback plan (regional failover + dedicated capacity options).
